_note: 英語島文法分區 sidecar：一檔一單元一 KP。unit_id＝KP id＝eng.t_sub.verb.future-perfect-progressive（未來完成進行式，tier t_adv／學測級）。形式＝will have been ＋ V-ing（現在分詞）。意思：到未來某個時點為止『將一直持續』的動作，常搭配 by／by the time ＋ for（一段時間）。時間子句鐵律：by the time ＋ 現在簡單式（不用 will）表未來（By the time you get home…）。形式鐵律：will have been working（不是 will have working／will have being／will had been）；進行式用現在分詞（working，不是 worked）。MCQ 每題唯一可辯護正解＋distractor_rationales＋answer_evidence。R14：teach body 全英文、中文放 zh_hint。以 Swan/Cambridge/Oxford 查證、status provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。含純文字 shadowing（無音檔）。

units.title_zh: 未來完成進行式（will have been ＋ V-ing）
units.can_do: 我能用未來完成進行式（will have been ＋ V-ing）表達『到未來某時點為止將一直持續』的動作，並正確搭配 by／by the time（時間子句用現在式）。
units.situation_group: 動詞時態 The future perfect progressive
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The future perfect progressive is formed with 'will have been' + the -ing form of the verb (present participle): 'She will have been teaching for twenty years.'
claims.verification_ref: 未來完成進行式＝will have been ＋ V-ing（現在分詞）（She will have been teaching for twenty years）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: It describes how long an action will have continued up to a specific point in the future, often with 'by' or 'by the time' and a duration with 'for': 'By next June, I will have been living here for ten years.'
claims.verification_ref: 表到未來某時點為止動作將持續多久，常搭配 by／by the time ＋ for（一段時間）（By next June, I will have been living here for ten years）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The future point is often given by a time clause with 'by the time' + a present-tense verb (not 'will'): 'By the time you arrive, we will have been waiting for three hours.' (the time clause uses 'arrive', not 'will arrive')
claims.verification_ref: 未來時點常由 by the time ＋ 現在簡單式子句給出、不用 will（By the time you arrive, we will have been waiting for three hours；時間子句用 arrive 不用 will arrive）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The future perfect progressive is 'will have been' + the -ing form of the verb (the present participle). We use it to say how long an action will have been going on up to a certain point in the future.
teach.zh_hint: 未來完成進行式＝will have been ＋ 動詞的 -ing 形（現在分詞）。用來表達『到未來某個時點為止，一個動作將已經持續了多久』。

teach.body: By next month, she will have been working at this company for five years.
teach.zh_hint: By next month, she will have been working at this company for five years.（到下個月，她在這家公司就工作滿五年了——到未來某點為止持續）

teach.body: It often goes with 'by' or 'by the time' to mark the future point, plus 'for' to give the length of time.
teach.zh_hint: 常搭配 by 或 by the time 標出未來的那個時點，再用 for 說明持續了多久。

teach.body: By 2030, they will have been running the shop for a decade.
teach.zh_hint: By 2030, they will have been running the shop for a decade.（到 2030 年，他們就經營這家店滿十年了）

teach.body: Important: when 'by the time' introduces a time clause, the verb in that clause is in the present simple, not 'will'. The 'will have been' + -ing goes in the main clause.
teach.zh_hint: 重要：當 by the time 引導時間子句時，該子句的動詞用現在簡單式，不用 will；will have been ＋ V-ing 放在主要子句。

teach.body: By the time you get home, I will have been cooking for two hours. (time clause: 'get', not 'will get')
teach.zh_hint: By the time you get home, I will have been cooking for two hours.（等你到家時，我就已經煮了兩小時的飯——時間子句用 get，不用 will get）

practice.stem: 填入正確：By next month, she ____ at this company for five years.（到下個月，她在這家公司就工作滿五年了）

distractor_rationales.will have working: 未來完成進行式是 will have been ＋ V-ing，缺了 been，不合文法。
distractor_rationales.will be working: 未來進行式只說未來某時正在做，無法表達『到下個月為止已持續滿五年』的累積時間。
distractor_rationales.has been working: 現在完成進行式連到現在；這裡講到未來的時點（By next month），要用 will have been。

practice.feedback: 到未來時點（By next month）為止持續五年 → will have been working。

practice.stem: 填入正確：By the time you ____ home, I will have been cooking for two hours.（等你到家時，我就已經煮了兩小時的飯）

distractor_rationales.will get: By the time 引導的時間子句用現在簡單式表未來，不用 will；用 get。
distractor_rationales.got: got 是過去式；這裡講未來的時點，時間子句用現在式 get。
distractor_rationales.will have got: 時間子句不用未來完成式；By the time ＋ 現在簡單式 get 即可。

practice.feedback: By the time ＋ 現在簡單式 get（表未來），主句才用 will have been cooking。

practice.stem: 選出未來完成進行式（will have been ＋ V-ing）形式完全正確的句子：
practice.answer: By 2030, they will have been running the shop for a decade.
options: By 2030, they will have been running the shop for a decade.
By 2030, they will have being running the shop for a decade.
By 2030, they will have been run the shop for a decade.
By 2030, they will had been running the shop for a decade.

distractor_rationales.By 2030, they will have being running th: 未來完成進行式用 will have been，不是 will have being。
distractor_rationales.By 2030, they will have been run the sho: 進行式要用現在分詞 running，不是原形/過去分詞 run。
distractor_rationales.By 2030, they will had been running the: will 後面接原形 have，不是 had；正確是 will have been。

practice.feedback: will have been ＋ V-ing（running），形式正確。

practice.stem: 填入正確：By the end of this year, we ____ in this house for twenty years.（到今年底，我們就住在這房子滿二十年了）

distractor_rationales.will live: 未來簡單式只說未來會住，無法表達『到今年底已持續滿二十年』的累積時間。
distractor_rationales.have been living: 現在完成進行式連到現在；這裡講到未來的時點（By the end of this year），用 will have been。
distractor_rationales.will have been lived: lived 是過去分詞（被動意味）；主動持續的動作用現在分詞 living。

practice.feedback: 到未來時點為止持續二十年 → will have been living。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句用未來完成進行式，表達『到未來某時點為止將一直持續的動作』？
practice.answer: By midnight, the team will have been coding for twelve hours straight.
options: By midnight, the team will have been coding for twelve hours straight.
The team will code all night.
The team is coding right now.
The team has been coding for twelve hours.

未來簡單式，只說未來會做，沒有『到未來某點為止持續多久』的累積意味。
現在進行式，講現在正在做，不是未來。
distractor_rationales.The team has been coding for twelve hour: 現在完成進行式，持續到現在；要講到未來某時點為止用 will have been。

practice.feedback: By midnight … will have been coding for twelve hours → 到未來時點為止將持續的動作。

practice.stem: 填入正確：When the marathon finishes, the winner ____ for just over two hours.（馬拉松結束時，冠軍就已經跑了兩個多小時）

distractor_rationales.will have been ran: 進行式要用現在分詞 running，不是過去式 ran（run 的過去分詞也是 run）。
distractor_rationales.will been running: 缺了 have；未來完成進行式是 will have been ＋ V-ing。
distractor_rationales.is running: 現在進行式，講現在；這裡講到未來某時點為止的持續，用 will have been running。

practice.feedback: 到未來時點（marathon finishes）為止持續兩個多小時 → will have been running。
